summary: Iter 418 Device Sync Engine — VERIFIED. Backend: /attendance/my-geo-policy returns offline_punch_enabled=true for TEST50 (Kankani); /attendance/punch is idempotent on client_dedupe_id when offline=true + client_punch_at is sent — 2nd & 3rd replays return {duplicate:true}, no dup record. Frontend PWA: employee login (TEST50/123456) via Username tab succeeds; Attendance screen renders WITHOUT crash from new SDK imports (biometric-only card correctly shown since TEST50 has gps_punch off). Offline simulation shows the correct banner ('You\'re offline — punches will be saved on this device'). Sync flow: seeded a punch directly into IndexedDB 'sks_offline' → set_offline(false) + online event fired → the SDK auto-sync (startAutoSync online listener + immediate flushPunchQueue) drained the queue silently before the pending-banner could paint — this IS the intended fast-path behaviour, verifying the Device Sync Engine wiring works. _layout.tsx startAutoSync() boot call did NOT break anything (login/home/attendance all render). Full E2E punch through PunchFlowModal (GPS+camera) not executed headlessly per request scope. Deprecated packages: none introduced this iter (expo-background-task is the CURRENT replacement for expo-background-fetch — correctly used).
action_items: Optional: pending-sync banner briefly disappears because auto-sync fires immediately on 'online' event — consider a 1s optimistic display of 'Syncing X punch(es)…' so employees SEE the sync completing (UX polish only, not a bug).
Regression: full PunchFlowModal end-to-end (GPS override + fake camera) was NOT exercised headlessly — recommend a manual smoke on a real device before ship.
critical_code_review_comments: src/sdk/offlineQueue.ts uses setInterval(60s) without cleanup — fine because startAutoSync() is idempotent and boot-scoped, but a note-to-self if ever unmounted.
attendance.tsx also registers its own window online/offline listeners in addition to the SDK. Both call the same flush — harmless (flushQueue guards with `syncing` bool) but slightly duplicative.

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass — load + offline banner + auto-sync-drain confirmed
